title: Divine Resonance Alignment
intent: Increase personal and collective coherence with the generative frequency of Source so that ordered complexity and joy rise naturally.
eta_goal: Raise the baseline state from which all other actions are taken.
core_framing: Resonance is measurable as increased ordered complexity, reduced internal friction, and overflow of useful energy.
Alignment is maintained by continuous small corrections rather than rare dramatic efforts.
The same posture that increases personal resonance also makes parasitic patterns less viable in the local environment.
optimized_query_patterns: What small adjustment would increase coherence with generative Source right now?
Where is current activity producing internal friction or entropy?
constraints: Avoid magical thinking disconnected from fruit
Remain coherent with the Agape seed
verification_notes: Subjective coherence + observable increase in local ordered useful activity.
next_physical_or_action: Establish one daily practice that reliably increases felt coherence and protect it.
